summary: Describes Public 4over6, a mechanism for giving IPv4 Internet connectivity over an IPv6 access network using global IPv4 addresses and IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnels, in a hub-and-spoke model. It is in use in places but not recommended for new deployments, where Lightweight 4over6 should be used.
